name: Haggis
summary: A 2-3 player climbing shedding game where players play higher sets, runs or bombs to capture tricks and score.
rules_text: Each player starts with J, Q, K face up as part of hand and usable as wilds in sets/sequences or as single rank; wild use as pair is prohibited since J-Q, J-K, Q-K, J-Q-K are bombs. Also bombs are 3-5-7-9 rainbow and suited. Deal 14 cards each from reduced deck, remainder is Haggis. Optional Little (15) or Big (30) bet that you will go out first. Player leads any combination: set of equal rank, sequence of 3+ consecutive same color, or sequence of 2+ consecutive sets sharing suits. Following players must play same type and card count but higher rank, or play any bomb to beat non-bomb, higher bomb to beat bomb, or pass. When all but one pass, highest combination captures all played cards, except bombs where next-highest capturer wins tricks. Winner leads new trick. Round ends when one player empties hand; they score 5 per card left in opponent with most cards, plus points from captured point cards (odd=1, J=2,Q=3,K=5). Bettor gains bet if first out, else bet points go to player who went out first and to any non-bettor.
